CATEGORY: re-occur: pronoun, zero, or N. (Coherence: reference)
definition: For a re-occurring referent, use a pronoun when it is close, zero form within the same clause, and repeat the noun/name when it is far away or something intervenes. Avoid too many repeated names or too many pronouns.

1 | otherwise it will be ambiguous, as if there are two persons to see and ask 神农
1 | it is confusing to have花 ; it looks like they refer to two different flowers, but actually the same. 吃一种叫夹竹桃的花的时候
1 | “妈妈” here is ambiguous

output.rule: For a re-occurring referent, use 他/她/它 when the referent is close, and do not repeat the noun/name unnecessarily. Repeat the noun/name when a pronoun would be ambiguous, especially after another person or thing intervenes; in quoted speech, use the pronoun that matches the speaker and listener.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <referent> is already clear/needs to be clear here, so use <pronoun/zero form/repeated noun> instead of <repeated noun/ambiguous pronoun>.

examples.explanation: 神农 → 他: 神农 is already clear here, so use 他; otherwise it is ambiguous, as if there are three people although there are only two.
孟子 → 他: 孟子 is already clear here, so replace the second 孟子 with 他.
另外一个人看见他。穿着棕色的人问神农 → 另外一个穿着棕色衣服的人，那个人问: repeat the description to make the person clear; otherwise it seems that two different people see and ask 神农.
夹竹桃 → 这个花: use 这个花 for the same flower; 花 is confusing because it looks like two different flowers.
他们 → 你们: in quoted speech, use 你们 for the people the speaker is talking to.

output.not_an_error: Do not replace a noun/name with a pronoun if the pronoun would be ambiguous, such as when another person or thing has intervened. In quoted speech, pronouns must match the speaker and listener.
